title: Matcher — which key item, if any, each finding re-finds
description: docs/members/study/roles/matcher.md (an aware role: matcher 1, matcher 2 and the tie-break all answer in this shape). The answers become matches-1.json, matches-2.json and tiebreak.json, which grade.mjs reads.

matches.description: One entry for every finding you were given, none skipped.

finding.description: The finding's id, exactly as given (F-…).

gold.description: The key item's id (A1, B2, S3, P1…), or null when score is 0.

score.description: 1: same place and same mechanism. 0.5: same place, the same mechanism said vaguely, never a different one. 0: anything else.

why.description: One short line: the place, and the mechanism on each side when they differ.
